title: Faheem Osman – Commodity QIS: An Under-Appreciated Source of Systematic Returns? (S7E29)

reader_summary.headline: I'm Corey Hofstein, and this is Flirting with Models.
reader_summary.overview: I'm Corey Hofstein, and this is Flirting with Models. The podcast that pulls back the curtain to discover the human factor behind the quantitative strategy. Due to industry regulations, you will not discuss any of newfound research as funds on this podcast.

key_points.text: In this episode, I speak with Faheem Osmond, managing director and global head of QIS structuring at Macquarie Group.

thesis: The episode explores commodity QIS as an under-appreciated source of systematic returns, highlighting strategies like curve carry and indexed congestion. It also discusses the historical performance of commodities, the reasons premiums persist, and the impact of zero DTE options on the basis-risk premium.
